messages:
Jamie (devex): Heads up — found a flaky repro in the onboarding sample app. When the app hits a transient 429, the SDK retries and we end up with duplicate records in the backend even though the app sets Idempotency-Key.
Sasha (sdk): yikes. Is the Idempotency-Key not being forwarded on the retry or is the key colliding?
Jamie (devex): It looks like two things: 1) the Node SDK was regenerating the idempotency key for retries in streaming/long-poll paths, and 2) when token refresh happens mid-retry we previously cleared custom headers. Logs attached below.
Prasad (eng-runtime): Can you paste the minimal curl + headers that reproduce? also include the server log snippet.
Jamie (devex): repro steps (minimal):
```
# initial request
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <shortlived>" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: onboarding-abc-123" \
  -d '{"prompt":"create_user"}'
# server returns 429, SDK retries automatically but the header becomes a new GUID in Node SDK
```
Server logs:
```
[2026-03-22T14:01:12Z] request_id=rcv-1 idempotency=onboarding-abc-123 -> side effect: insert user 42
[2026-03-22T14:01:13Z] request_id=rcv-2 idempotency=onboarding-6f9d -> side effect: insert user 43
```
Sasha (sdk): Huh. Node SDK behavior diverges from Python? I thought both preserved idempotency header by default.
Jamie (devex): Python SDK preserved the header in this case. Node did not — it tried to be "helpful" and generate a new idempotency key for the retry path, which is wrong for user-supplied keys.
Olivia (product): That's bad for onboarding flows — duplicates are very visible to users. What's the proposed fix?
Prasad (eng-runtime): Fix 1: SDKs MUST preserve any Idempotency-Key provided by caller across retries (including after token refresh). Fix 2: SDKs should attach a distinct internal header (x-rw-replay-id) for observability but not replace idempotency for dedupe. Fix 3: add a configurable safe_replay_window_ms (default 120000) to treat retries beyond the window as new requests.
Sasha (sdk): Agree. Also propose default client jitter/backoff tweak: current jitter range in Node is 0-1000ms which interacts badly with server Retry-After. We should prefer honoring Retry-After when present, else use randomized exponential backoff with full-jitter per AWS paper.
Jamie (devex): If we add safe_replay_window_ms, sample app tests should assert: within window = no duplicate side-effects when same idempotency-key; outside window = allowed to create new resources.
Prasad (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR in the monorepo to: 1) stop auto-regeneration of idempotency on retries, 2) persist caller headers across token refresh, 3) add x-rw-replay-id. Will add unit + e2e tests simulating token rotation mid-retry.
Sasha (sdk): I'll update Node/Python/Go SDKs to match behavior. For Node, quick patch is three lines. I'll also add an opt-in strictMode that fails fast if user provides an idempotency-key and retry would override it.
Jamie (devex): Can we also update the onboarding sample app to show recommended pattern: set Idempotency-Key and show how to inspect x-rw-replay-id in logs? New sample test should run against canary.
Prasad (eng-runtime): deploy-bot: canary-rollout to staging triggered for sha: abcd1234
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging (region-us-east-1)
Olivia (product): Prioritize this as P1 for next sprint; duplicate accounts = bad activation metrics.
Sasha (sdk): I'll aim to land Node patch today and cut a patch release. Will post PR link once ready.
Jamie (devex): Thanks — once PRs land, I'll add a short repro test to the onboarding CI to catch regressions.
Prasad (eng-runtime): PRs: (placeholder) https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/XXXX - will update when created.
Jamie (devex): thx all :raised_hands:
